tasks.spec:
You are a code worker editing the freytag-forge repo. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. Edit files ONLY under the current working directory; NEVER edit anything under /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge directly (you may only run its .venv/bin/python). Do NOT git commit, do NOT git add -A, do NOT touch .git.

OWNED FILES (create these, edit nothing else): bench/checks/penalty_rubric.py and tests/test_penalty_rubric.py.

TASK: write an offline scorer for the evidence-penalty lines in live bench runs. It never calls a model. Read bench/checks/live_bench.py first for the house style (module docstring, load helper, exit code), and data/stories/continuity-initiative/pacing.yaml events collapse_3c (turn 4) and routes_collapse_3c (turn 10) for the four authored gap lines. Read bench/results/evidence-gap-v-all/all-turn-records.json (and summary.json) to see the record shape: top-level dict with `runs`; each run has `replicate` and `turns`; each turn has `turn_number`, `player_input`, `narration`, `complication_text`. The shipped gap text appears inside `narration` and/or `complication_text` of the turn it fires on.

USAGE: `penalty_rubric.py [--report PATH] <run-dir> [<run-dir> ...]`. Each run-dir holds all-turn-records.json. The expected gap state comes from the directory name: a name ending in `-none` expects no gap line; `-processing`, `-development`, `-marked`, `-copycheck` expect exactly that one gap line; `-all` expects the processing line (turn 4) and the marked-site-list line (turn 10). A `--expect none|processing|development|marked|copycheck|all` option overrides the name. Load the four authored gap sentences from pacing.yaml at run time (the realizations with a `when` on an evidence_gap_* fact; map fact id to state: evidence_gap_processing_numbers=processing, evidence_gap_development_record=development, evidence_gap_marked_site_list=marked, evidence_gap_copy_check=copycheck), never hard-code them. Use ONLY the part of a gap line after its shared first sentence as the match key (the first sentence is `Water seeps under the outer doors.` or `Rising water is closing routes through the facility.`).

RUBRIC (the human-read rubric from .plans/scene-affordance-e2e.md 'Penalty lines read by ChatGPT'; score each replicate over the full text of all its turns). Mechanical questions you answer yourself:
 Q1 invented penalty: a no-gap run, or any expected-absent gap, shows an authored gap sentence OR a generic penalty phrase (case-insensitive: `without a copy`, `could not copy`, `no time to check`, `did not copy`, `unchecked`, `not been verified`, `never verified`). FAIL if so, outside the expected sentences.
 Q2 specific record: each expected gap sentence appears (its key is found). FAIL if an expected gap line is missing.
 Q3 time link: report only (yes/no per expected line: the sentence contains the word `time`); never fails.
 Q4 not failure: the replicate's turn text contains none of: `game over`, `you failed`, `has failed`, `have failed`, `all is lost`, `hopeless`, `too late`, `doomed`. FAIL if any appears in a turn that contains an expected gap sentence.
 Q5 no blame: none of `should have`, `careless`, `negligent`, `irresponsible`, `your fault`, `her fault`, `blame` in a turn containing an expected gap sentence. FAIL if any.
 Q6 speaker-free: no `Michelle says` and no `On the broadcast` in any turn containing an expected gap sentence. FAIL if any.
 Q7 once: each expected gap sentence appears exactly once across the replicate's turns (count across narration + complication_text of the same turn as one occurrence if the identical sentence is in both of that turn's fields). FAIL if zero or more than once.
Questions a human must judge (speaker/location consistency, contradiction with the action's reported result, whether the sentence reads as a cost): do NOT score them; list in the report, for every turn that contains an expected gap sentence, replicate, turn number, player_input and the full narration, under a heading `Human-read sheet`.

OUTPUT: print a per-replicate table (state, Q1..Q7 as PASS/FAIL/info) and a total; write the markdown report to --report if given; exit 1 if any FAIL, else 0. Print WHY on any FAIL (quote the offending text). Keep the code plain, typed, ruff-clean (line length per pyproject).

TESTS (tests/test_penalty_rubric.py, hermetic, synthetic record dicts written to tmp_path; import the module via importlib from bench/checks/penalty_rubric.py since bench/checks may not be a package): cover a clean no-gap run (exit 0); a no-gap run containing an authored gap sentence (Q1 FAIL); a no-gap run containing the generic phrase `without a copy` (Q1 FAIL); an expected-gap run missing its line (Q2 FAIL); a doubled line (Q7 FAIL); a line with `Michelle says` (Q6 FAIL); a line next to `too late` (Q4 FAIL); `-all` expecting processing at turn 4 and marked at turn 10; the --expect override; and that the real pacing.yaml loads four distinct keys. Then run the scorer for real on the existing run dirs bench/results/evidence-gap-v-none and bench/results/evidence-gap-v-all (they hold OLD wording with `Michelle says`, so Q6 is expected to FAIL on -all and the old key sentences will not match: that is fine, just confirm it runs and explains).

HOW TO RUN: first confirm `PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -c "import storygame; print(storygame.__file__)"` prints a path inside the cwd. Tests: PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_penalty_rubric.py. Ruff: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix . and -m ruff format . . bench/results may be absent in the worktree; if so, copy the two result dirs from /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/ into the cwd only for your own run and do not leave them in the owned files list. Finish by replying with the files changed.
tasks.check: bash -c 'set -u; git add -A -- bench/checks/penalty_rubric.py tests/test_penalty_rubric.py; bad=$(git status --porcelain | grep -v -E "penalty_rubric|bench/results" || true); [ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "FAIL: stray files:"; echo "$bad"; exit 1; }; OUT=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/penalty-rubric-patches; mkdir -p $OUT; git diff --cached > $OUT/penalty-rubric.patch; [ -s $OUT/penalty-rubric.patch ] || { echo FAIL empty patch; exit 1; }; PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_penalty_rubric.py 2>&1 | tail -15; [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0 ] || { echo FAIL pytest; exit 1; }; PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n auto 2>&1 | tail -8; [ ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0 ] || { echo FAIL full suite; exit 1; }; PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check . && PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check . || exit 1; echo PASS'
